feedback.claim: The audit brief repeatedly describes the v2 manifest fixture matrix as 35 indexed vectors, but the supplied fixture manifest contains more vectors, so the review target count is internally inconsistent.
feedback.evidence: The Change intent says “indexed mutation vectors” and the Review targets item 4 asks whether “the 35 indexed vectors test the claimed failure stage”; Current checks also says isolated contract discovery passed “35 indexed manifest vectors.” However `contracts/pack-fixture-manifest.v2.json` lists vectors from `wrong_runtime` through `presentation_order_retained`, including additional positive scalar and ordering vectors beyond 35.
feedback.recommended_change: Align the stated vector count with the fixture manifest, preferably by replacing hard-coded “35 indexed vectors” wording with the actual count or with count-neutral wording such as “the indexed manifest vectors.”
feedback.severity_rationale: This does not change manifest semantics or authority boundaries, but it can mislead the bounded audit and acceptance evidence about which vectors were reviewed and passed.
